appliedScenePlan.consequence: A collapsed ceiling panel, wet ceiling runoff, and a scorch-marked temporary price sign; the stroller is knocked farther from the column. The creature's reflection is imprinted in the smudged steel and a child's shoe lies nearby.
appliedScenePlan.nextHook: scorched sign and child's shoe near the mirrored column with the creature's reflection
appliedScenePlan.stillPrompt: Phone-photo documentarian frame of the unfinished Kaufhaus in mixed light: dense dark smoke blooming beneath exposed ducts, a collapsed ceiling panel and wet streaks from sprinklers, construction dust falling. In the immediate foreground, a mirrored steel column shows heavy smudges; perched on its upper edge and already visible at the start is a large crouched creature (render from canonical reference image) — its silhouette and texture reflected in the steel. The scene preserves raw concrete, cable trays, old fluorescent fixtures, scattered construction clutter, and modest dynamic range. The creature is shown as part of the start frame (no emergence), stationary at the column.
appliedScenePlan.videoPrompt: Static-to-pan shot: begin on the still start-frame where the creature is already perched; then slowly pan and descend as thick smoke blooms, sprinklers drip, dust falls and people scramble off-camera. Camera captures the sprinkling water, the collapsing ceiling panel, and the stroller being knocked aside; the creature remains visible but does not enter or appear during the motion (no emergence).
appliedScenePlan.cameraCue: High-ish wide-angle ~28mm, pulled back slightly then slow downward pan after the smoke release to reveal ceiling damage and the creature's fixed perch; camera chosen after the smoke has released to reveal the perched figure.

appliedScenePlan.title: Tagged for Consumption
appliedScenePlan.event: In the aftermath people begin to repurpose the ruin into trade: makeshift stalls are set up, scorched partitions and damaged goods are hastily price-tagged and barcoded; volunteers wheel up a portable checkout. The creature is again present at the start of the frame, observed crouched beside a shelf of salvaged items, its reflection visible in the smudged mirrored column while customers treat the damage as inventory.
appliedScenePlan.consequence: Price tags and barcodes cover formerly hazardous stains and scorch marks; a small pop-up checkout with a handheld scanner sits under the mirrored column, the child's shoe and stroller now plate the improvised market.
appliedScenePlan.nextHook: price-tagged damages and the creature lingering near the checkout
appliedScenePlan.stillPrompt: Phone-photo realism: the Kaufhaus interior now occupied by improvised stalls and a pop-up checkout, scorched partitions draped with price tags, goods stacked on construction pallets. Mixed cold window light and warm practical lamps, exposed ducts, cable trays and dust-laden concrete remain visible. In the frame's background the same creature from its canonical reference image is present at the start, crouched by a smudged mirrored steel column beside the checkout, its reflection faint in the steel. Shoppers and volunteers barcode-tag items; modest dynamic range, ordinary phone-photo imperfections.
appliedScenePlan.videoPrompt: Medium handheld shot: people tag and barcode goods, a scanner chirps, price tags flutter, a volunteer rearranges salvage into neat stacks; the camera tracks the checkout action while the creature remains visible but largely still beside the column (no emergence or entrance during motion). Ambient fluorescent flicker and the distant hum of conversation are audible.
appliedScenePlan.cameraCue: Mid-shot ~35mm at shoulder height, slight handheld roll that lingers on the checkout transaction then frames the creature in the background after the stalls and tags have been set.
